templates.pattern: [N] people [P1], [P2], [P3], [P4], [P5] sit in a row. [P1] sits at the leftmost end. [P5] sits at the rightmost end. [P3] sits exactly in the middle. Who sits to the immediate right of [P3]?
templates.explanation: Order: [P1]-[P2]-[P3]-[P4]-[P5]. [P3] is in middle (pos 3), so immediate right is pos 4 = [P4]

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a straight row facing north. [P1] is at position [POS1] from left. [P2] is at position [POS2] from left. How many persons sit between [P1] and [P2]?
[N] people sit in a row. [P1] is [K] places to the left of [P2]. [P2] is at position [POS] from the right end. What is [P1]'s position from the left end?
templates.explanation: [P2] position from left = N-POS+1 = [N]-[POS]+1. [P1] is [K] left of [P2], so [P1] pos from left = [N]-[POS]+1-[K]

templates.pattern: [N] persons sit in a row. [P1] is at position [A] from left. What is [P1]'s position from the right end?
templates.explanation: Position from right = N - Position from left + 1 = [N]-[A]+1

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] children, [P1] is [A]th from the left and [P2] is [B]th from the left. [P3] sits exactly between [P1] and [P2]. What is [P3]'s position from the left?
In a row of [N] persons, if [P1] is shifted [K] places to the right, he occupies the middle position. What is [P1]'s original position from the left?
templates.explanation: Middle position = (N+1)/2. Original position = middle - K = [N+1]/2 - [K]

templates.pattern: [N] people sit in a circle. [P1] is [A] places to the right of [P2]. How many people are between them going from [P2] to [P1] in the longer (left) direction?
templates.explanation: Longer direction count = N - shorter direction - 2 = [N]-[A]-1

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] students, [P1] is [A]th from left and [P2] is [B]th from right. Total number of students between them?
In a row of [N] people, [P1] is [A]th from left. If [K] more people join the row to the left of [P1], what is [P1]'s new position from left?
templates.explanation: New position from left = original position + people added to left = [A]+[K]

templates.pattern: [N] athletes sit in a row. [P1] is [A]th from left and [B]th from right. How many athletes are in the row?
templates.explanation: Total = Position from left + Position from right - 1 = [A]+[B]-1

templates.pattern: In a row of [N] persons, [P1] is exactly in the middle. [P1] is [A]th from the right. How many persons are to the left of [P1]?
templates.explanation: Since [P1] is in the middle, position from right = position from left. Left of [P1] = A-1 = [A]-1

templates.pattern: [N] players sit in a row. [P1] is [A] places to the right of [P2]. [P2] is at position [B] from left. What is [P1]'s position from right?
templates.explanation: [P1] position from left = A+B = [A]+[B]. From right = N-(A+B)+1 = [N]-([A]+[B])+1

templates.pattern: In a linear row of [N] people facing north, [P1] is [A]th from left. [P2] is [B] places to the right of [P1]. What is [P2]'s position from the right?
templates.explanation: [P2] from left = A+B. [P2] from right = N-(A+B)+1 = [N]-([A]+[B])+1
